newsitem.title: USA: Argosy Gaming benefits from casino votes.
newsitem.headline: Argosy Gaming benefits from casino votes.

text.p: Argosy Gaming Co said voters in East Baton Rouge Parish, La. on Tuesday approved a proposition to allow riverboat gaming to continue in their parish.
This is an area where the company operates the Belle of Baton Rouge.

Argosy also said its development project, a riverboat casino in Lawrenceburg, Ind., on the Ohio River, got a boost Tuesday when voters in Hamilton County, Ohio, and the Buckeye State rejected a proposition to allow operation of riverboat casinos.
This eliminates the threat of three competing riverboat casinos in the Cincinnati market, near Argosy's Lawrenceburg, project.
